fact: The law published on 6 June 2025 creating the IPI and ITI codes states that the property tax matrices are profoundly outdated and that no property valuation system existed, and provides for cadastre-based valuation of rustic properties, from 1 January 2026.
title: Boletim Oficial n.º 46, I Série de 06-06-2025
publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde
